0.original: Xeerol Ja is ready to bring another juice to fruition.

1.original: Xeerol Ja has tasked you with creating prickly pear juice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 260. Delivering items with a rating of 530 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the prickly pear juice to Xeerol Ja. Since you have some time before the tasting party, you may wish to hone your craft.

24.original: Deliver prickly pear juice to Xeerol Ja.

48.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “The Long Road to Xak Tural.”

49.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh! Xeerol Ja's spirits seem airylight! Thanks to Halnaruk's juicypulp, yes?

51.original: I've got a plan for the Pelupelu prototype. Do you have a moment to spare?

52.original: Recall that fellow in Wachunpelo who was out of sorts after overindulging in mezcal.

53.original: You see it all the time in Tuliyollal─Pelupelu merchants sharing a bottle or two, and then those who can't help but drink their better sense away.

54.original: Water is a foolproof companion to alcohol, but perhaps we might offer a juice that addresses the headaches and nausea come the following day.

55.original: A remedy for sickfeels is sure to appeal to tipsy Pelupelu! But what ingredients would we need for the craftymaking?

56.original: In addition to the hydration water provides, certain vitamins and minerals may prove essential to relieving symptoms.

57.original: The tunas found in Shaaloani, for instance, are brimming with nutrients.

58.original: But you're from across the salt, aren't you? Forgive me─sometimes I forget. When I say “tunas,” I mean the fruits of our nopalitenders. I trust you saw a few of those little cacti scurrying about when you went to Shaaloani?

59.original: I'm glad we didn't lose you to Xak Tural. There are so many wonders to be had up there, I wouldn't have been surprised if my little juice stand slipped your mind entirely.

60.original: But I digress! I heard from a native Xak Turali that nopalitender tunas provide just the sort of relief we're looking for.

61.original: Apparently, some peoples up north eat tunas for breakfast after a long night of drinking. A natural cure to the aftereffects of alcohol!

62.original: By using these fruits in our next juice, we might offer the Pelupelu just the cure they need!

63.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh! With a curedrink for achy braincases, Pelupelu can drinkdrunk without worry!

64.original: I have every faith in your skill, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Blend us a batch of juice made from the tunas of nopalitenders, and add whatever you think might ease the “achy braincase” of a Pelupelu.

65.original: In the meantime, I'll be hard at work selling the juices we've made together. Let me know when you have a sample ready!

67.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh. If this juicymix can relieve sickfeels, more than just Pelupelu will be eager to siptaste.

68.original: Extract the juice from nopalitender tunas─er, would you prefer I call them prickly pears?─and feel free to add vitamins and minerals as you see fit.

69.original: Lovely, thank you! We'll have our tasting once a full batch is prepared.

70.original: I can tell by scent alone that our Pelupelu customers will be thrilled! We'll have our tasting once a full batch is prepared.

71.original: Lovely, thank you! Now, Ropli has agreed to be our taster─let me go and fetch him.

72.original: I can tell by scent alone that our Pelupelu customers will be thrilled! Now, Ropli has agreed to be our taster─let me go and fetch him.

73.original: A juice blend bespoke to the Pelupelu palate? Don't mind if I do...

74.original: Well, clip my wool and call me an alpaca─this is delicious! Intensely sweet, yet satisfying to swallow!

75.original: I'm so glad! It's meant to be a morning drink─specifically after a night of revelry.

76.original: A relief for the maladies of merriment! Now that's a sublime idea. I'd wager even folks from across the salt are no stranger to such illnesses.

77.original: I myself enjoy a good drink for both business and pleasure, but I always dread the blinding headaches and discomfort the next day.

78.original: The same goes for plenty of Pelupelu─so a beverage that offers succor to the more enthusiastic of our number is a godssend indeed.

79.original: Thank you. Your creation shows us a kindness that has me eager to test out its efficacy at once.

82.original: You'll be drinking them all under the table in no time!

83.original: Whose juice do I have to mix to get an invitation?

84.original: I do my best not to overindulge, but, well, as drink pours, so flies judgment. Knowing this juice will be here to soak up any regrets is a great comfort.

85.original: A fellow reveler, I take it? Then allow me to extend you an invitation as soon as the next opportunity presents itself.

87.original: When your rent began drying up, I couldn't help but worry. But I am happy to see that Xeerol Ja Juicecraft is flourishing here in Wachumeqimeqi.

88.original: I'm deeply sorry about the late payments... But as you can see, my financial situation has improved significantly thanks to <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>'s help in expanding my menu.

89.original: Given our diverse selection of drinks, I was hoping we might hold a tasting party in the city sometime.

90.original: A juice for everyone in Wachumeqimeqi! My gesture of thanks to the community and contrition for all the times I failed to be timely with my rent.

91.original: Be honest─you're just eager for folks to taste your creations, aren't you?

92.original: <sigh> You're right! I'm proud of our work, and I'd like the city to taste the fruits of our labor.

93.original: That's the spirit. I'll make the arrangements.

94.original: Sippyparty will need lots of juicymix─and for lots of juicymix, we need lots of mixybits! Halnaruk will stuffseek until his pack is bursting!

95.original: A tasting party of our very own! I can hardly wait─oh, there's so much to do! But leave the planning to me─I'll be in touch with the details very soon!

96.original: Xeerol Ja is thrilled with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pelupelu Panacea Provider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

97.original: The next quest will be available from Xeerol Ja upon reaching level 100 as an alchemist or culinarian.

98.original: In order to undertake the subsequent quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “The Protector and the Destroyer.”
